question: What is the BUD for a single dose container ampule from the time of puncture in a sterile environment?

1.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: For a single-dose ampule (which cannot be resealed after opening/breaking), USP <797> and related sterile compounding standards require immediate use only; the contents cannot be stored. Thus the BUD from time of opening/puncture—even in an ISO 5 sterile environment—is effectively zero (use right away and discard any remainder). 

This differs from single-dose vials, which may have a 6-hour BUD when opened in ISO 5 conditions. Ampules are treated more strictly due to lack of a closure.

There is therefore no extended BUD (i.e., use immediately; 0-hour storage allowance). 

(The 6-hour allowance applies only to punctured single-dose vials that remain in ISO 5 conditions, not to non-resealable ampules.)
